email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Ma la baajiyaa dhammaan farriimaha hadda safka ugu jira qaatahan? Nuxurkooda waa la tirtiri doonaa oo dib looma soo celin karo. Farriimaha cusub ee la abuuro codsigan ka dib waa la haynayaa.
email-recovery-description: Hal saf ayaa u gaar ah qaata kasta. Ku raadi aqoonsiga isticmaalaha. Nuxurka farriinta iyo meelaha iimaylka qaataha lama muujiyo. Hakad geli waxay haysaa farriimaha hadda jira iyo kuwa mustaqbalka; Sii wad waxay hadda dib u tijaabisaa dirista farriimaha safka ku jira. Baaji waxay tirtirtaa farriimaha safka la geliyey ilaa waqtiga codsiga. Haddii diristu mashquul tahay, wax yar ka dib isku day mar kale. Farriin durba la dirayo dib looma soo celin karo, diris aan natiijadeeda la hubinna waa la celin karaa. Fashilaadaha joogtada ah iyo farriimaha gaadhay xadka isku dayada waxay u sii furnaanayaan dib u eegis. Dib u tijaabinta farriimaha fashilmay waxay bilowdaa wareeg cusub oo isku dayo ah, waxayna ilaalisaa hakadkii hore u jiray.
email-recovery-empty: Ma jiraan farriimo safka ku jira ama qaateyaal diristooda la hakiyey.
email-recovery-failed: Hawsha lama xaqiijin karin. Cusboonaysii safka oo ku celi isla hawsha haddii loo baahdo.
email-recovery-oldest: Markii ugu horraysay ee safka la geliyey
email-recovery-superseded: Hawl cusub oo hawlwadeenku sameeyey ayaa beddeshay codsigan. Xaaladda hadda ee safka ayaa la muujinayaa.
email-recovery-unavailable: Safka iimaylka lama akhrin karo. Hubi oggolaanshaha maamulka iyo helitaanka adeegaha.

import-board-instruction-asana: Ku dheji dhoofinta hawlaha Asana ee JSON ({ "data": [...] } oo ka timid dhoofinta Asana ama GET /tasks). Hawlaha waxaa loo ururiyaa qaybo (memberships); hawlaha dhammaystiran waxay tagaan Done.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Businessmap (hore Kanbanize) gudihiisa, fur Advanced Search, dooro Configure results si aad u doorato tiirarka, soo deji faylka Excel, kadibna dooro faylkaas .xlsx. Tiirarka waxaa lagu akhriyaa magacyadooda Ingiriisiga (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): haddii akoonkaagu isticmaalo luqad kale, marka hore u beddel safka cinwaanka Ingiriisi. Column wuxuu noqdaa liisas, Lane-na waddooyin; milkiilayaasha, summadaha, midabka, taariikhaha, faallooyinka iyo xiriiriyeyaasha waalidka meeshooda ayay ku hadhaan, Priority, Size, Type iyo tiirarka kalena waxay noqdaan goobo gaar ah.
import-board-instruction-clickup: ClickUp gudihiisa, soo saar hawlaha sidii CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, ama soo saarista muuqaal List ama Table oo leh dhammaan tiirarka), kadibna dhaji CSV-ga. Xaaladaha waxay noqdaan liisas, liisaska ClickUp waxay noqdaan waddooyin, hawlahana waxay noqdaan kaarar leh hawlahooda hoose, dadka loo xilsaaray, summadaha, taariikhaha, mudnaanta iyo waqtiga.
import-board-instruction-csv: Ku dheji Qiimayaasha Hakadka Lagu Kala Saaray (CSV)/ Qiimayaasha Tab Lagu Kala Saaray (TSV).
import-board-instruction-deck: Ku dheji JSON sabuurad NextCloud Deck ah (sabuurad leh "stacks", stack kastaana sida "cards"). Stacks waxay noqdaan liisas, cards-na waxay noqdaan kaarar.
import-board-instruction-excel: Dooro xaashi .xlsx ah oo qaabka WeKan ah (tiirarka la midka ah dhoofinta Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Safka koowaad waa madaxa.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Ka fur faylka .boardarchive isku-ururinta oo ku dheji waxa ku jira board.jsonl ee looxa, iyadoo sadarka noocu jiro ama uusan jirin. Sifada kooxaynta ee muuqaalka looxu waxay noqotaa liisas, sifooyinka kale ee xulashadu waxay noqdaan calaamado, qaybaha qoraalka iyo sanduuqyada calaamadintu waxay noqdaan sharaxaad iyo liiska hubinta, faallooyinkana waa la hayaa. Sawirrada iyo lifaaqyada lama soo dejiyo.
import-board-instruction-issues: Ku dheji safka JSON ee arrimaha __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Arrimuhu waxay noqdaan kaarar loo ururiyay liisaska Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Ku dheji JSON dhoofinta Kanboard: walax leh "columns" (ama hawlo sida column_name u sida) iyo saf "tasks" ah (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns waxay noqdaan liisas, tasks-na waxay noqdaan kaarar.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Kanri gudihiisa, fur Import & Export oo dooro Export individual board (ama Export all data), kadibna dhaji faylka .json. Tiirarku waxay noqdaan liisas, kaararkuna waxay noqdaan kaarar, iyagoo leh sharaxaaddooda, taariikhda ugu dambeysa, summadaha iyo midabada; hawlaha kaarku waxay noqdaan liis hubin. Soo saarista dhammaan xogta, sabuuradda koowaad ayaa la soo dejiyaa.
import-board-instruction-leo: Ku dheji qaab-dhismeed Leo ah (fayl .leo ah). Qaybaha heerka ugu sarreeya waxay noqdaan liisas, qaybaha si toos ah uga hoos baxana waxay noqdaan kaarar iyadoo qoraalka qaybtu yahay sharraxaadda kaarka. Qaybaha heerarka ka sii hooseeya waxay noqdaan liisas hubin. Qaybaha calaamadaysan waxaa loo soo dejiyaa kuwo la dhammaystiray.
import-board-instruction-linear: Linear gudihiisa, soo saar arrimaha sidii CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, ama soo saarista muuqaal), kadibna dhaji CSV-ga. Xaaladaha waxay noqdaan liisas, kooxaha waxay noqdaan waddooyin, arrimahana waxay noqdaan kaarar leh qofka loo xilsaaray, calaamadaha, taariikhaha, arrinta waalidka, mudnaanta, qiyaasta, mashruuca iyo wareegga.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Ku dheji liiska hawlaha markdown (heshiiska ay isticmaalaan qalabka markdown-kanban sida Obsidian Kanban): cinwaanka "## Magaca liiska", oo leh walxo "- [ ]"/"- [x]" hoosta ka yaal. Cinwaannadu waxay noqdaan liisas walxuhuna waxay noqdaan kaararka.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: MeisterTask gudihiisa, guji magaca mashruuca, dooro Export project oo soo saar CSV, kadibna dhaji. Qaybaha waxay noqdaan liisas, hawlahana waxay noqdaan kaarar, iyagoo leh qoraalladooda, taariikhda ugu dambeysa, qofka loo xilsaaray iyo summadaha; hawlaha la dhammeeyay waxay hayaan taariikhda la dhammeeyay. CSV loo qoray soo dejinta MeisterTask laftiisa sidoo kale waa shaqeysaa.
import-board-instruction-monday: monday.com gudihiisa, fur menu-ga sabuuradda, dooro More actions iyo Export board to Excel (haddii aad rabto, la socda cusboonaysiinta iyo walxaha hoose), kadibna dooro faylkaas .xlsx. Tiirka Status wuxuu noqdaa liisas, kooxuhuna waxay noqdaan waddooyin; dadka, taariikhaha, jadwalka iyo summadaha meeshooda ayay ku hadhaan, tiirarka kalena waxay noqdaan goobo gaar ah, cusboonaysiintuna waxay noqotaa faallooyin.
import-board-instruction-notion: Notion gudihiisa, u fur xogta sidii bog buuxa, dooro ••• iyo Export, dooro Markdown & CSV, oo dooro faylka .zip ee la soo dejiyo, ama hal CSV xog ah oo ka mid ah, ama dhaji CSV-gaas. Tiir la yiraahdo Status wuxuu noqdaa liisas (haddii uusan jirin, tiirka koowaad ee u eg doorasho ayaa noqda, warbixinta soo dejintuna way sheegtaa kan); safafku waxay noqdaan kaarar leh cinwaankooda, summadaha sidii calaamado, dadka sidii xubno, taariikhaha, iyo qoraalka bogga sidii sharaxaad; tiirarka kale waxay noqdaan goobo gaar ah. Xiriirada, sawirada iyo lifaaqyada lama soo dejiyo.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Nullboard gudihiisa, fur sabuuradda, ka dooro menu-ga Export this board..., ku fur faylka .nbx tifaftire qoraal oo dhaji waxa ku jira. Liisasku waxay noqdaan liisas, qoraalladuna waxay noqdaan kaarar: sadarka koowaad ee qoraalka waa cinwaanka kaarka, inta kalena waa sharaxaaddiisa. Qoraal raw ah wuxuu helaa calaamadda raw. Fayl leh sabuuradro badan wuxuu soo dejiyaa sabuuradda koowaad.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Obsidian gudihiisa, u fur faylka sabuuradda Kanban sidii Markdown (ama ku fur faylka .md tifaftire qoraal), kadibna dhaji dhammaan. Waddooyinku waxay noqdaan liisas leh xadka kaararkooda, kaararku waxay hayaan summadahooda, taariikhaha, mudnaanta, goobaha iyo liiska hubinta, Archive-kuna wuxuu noqdaa kaarar la kaydiyay.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Ku dheji ururinta work-packages JSON ee OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses waxay noqdaan liisas, work packages-na waxay noqdaan kaarar.
import-board-instruction-opml: Dhaji qorshe OPML ah, sida ay u soo saaraan Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq iyo qalabka kale ee qorshaynta. Walxaha heerka sare waxay noqdaan liisas, carruurtooda waxay noqdaan kaarar oo qoraalku yahay sharaxaadda, walxaha ka hooseeyana waxay noqdaan liisas hubin. Walxaha la dhammeeyay waxaa loo soo dejiyaa sidii la qabtay.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Dhaji fayl Org mode ah, sida ay u qoraan Emacs, Orgzly ama Beorg. Cinwaanada heerka sare waxay noqdaan liisas, cinwaanada heerka labaadna waxay noqdaan kaarar. TODO iyo DONE, mudnaanta, summadaha, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE iyo CLOSED waa la hayaa, sanduuqyada calaamadeynta iyo cinwaanada ka hooseeyana waxay noqdaan liisas hubin.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Pivotal Tracker gudihiisa, fur tab-ka MORE ee mashruuca oo dooro Export CSV (ama dooro sheekooyin oo dooro Bulk Actions, CSV), kadibna dhaji CSV-ga. Xaalad kasta oo sheeko waxay noqotaa liis, sheekooyinkuna waxay noqdaan kaarar, iyagoo leh noocooda iyo calaamadahooda, milkiilayaasha, codsadaha, taariikhaha, faallooyinka, hawlaha iyo caqabadaha; Estimate wuxuu noqdaa Story points, wareegyaduna waxay noqdaan sprint-yo.
import-board-instruction-plane: Plane gudihiisa, fur Workspace Settings, dooro Exports, u soo saar mashaariicda sidii JSON, CSV ama Excel oo soo deji faylka .zip, kadibna dooro faylkaas, ama hal fayl oo ku dhex jira, ama dhaji JSON-ka ama CSV-ga. Xaaladaha waxay noqdaan liisas, mashaariicdu waxay noqdaan waddooyin, arrimahuna waxay noqdaan kaarar leh aqoonsigooda, waalidka, dadka loo xilsaaray, calaamadaha, taariikhaha, xiriiriyeyaasha iyo faallooyinka; mudnaanta, qiyaasta, wareegga iyo moduul-ka waxay noqdaan goobo gaar ah. Soo saarista Plane ma laha sharaxaado ama lifaaqyo, sidaa darteed lama soo dejiyo.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-quire: Quire gudihiisa, fur menu-ga mashruuca oo dooro Export CSV, kadibna dhaji CSV-ga. Xaaladaha waxay noqdaan liisas, hawluhuna waxay noqdaan kaarar, iyagoo leh hawlahooda hoose sidii kaarar carruur ah, dadka loo xilsaaray, summadaha sidii calaamado, taariikhaha bilowga, ugu dambeynta iyo dhammaystirka, sharaxaadda iyo mudnaanta sidii goob gaar ah. Faallooyinka iyo lifaaqyada kuma jiraan CSV-ga Quire.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Redmine gudihiisa, fur Issues-ka mashruuca, dooro Also available in: CSV ee hoose ee liiska, dooro tiirarka (All columns, oo leh Description) oo soo saar, kadibna dhaji CSV-ga. Redmine wuxuu tiirarka ugu magac daraa luqaddaada, sidaa darteed ka hor soo saarista u deji luqaddaada Ingiriisi My account gudihiisa. Xaalad kasta waxay noqotaa liis, arrimahuna waxay noqdaan kaarar, iyagoo leh tracker-ka sidii calaamad, qofka loo xilsaaray, qoraaga, taariikhaha, hawsha waalidka iyo arrimaha la xiriira; mudnaanta, qaybta, nooca la beegsanayo, waqtiga la qiyaasay, % Done iyo goobaha gaarka ah waxay noqdaan goobo gaar ah.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Super Productivity gudihiisa, fur Settings, kadib Sync & Backup, dooro Export Data oo dhaji waxa ku jira faylka sp-backup .json. Mashruuc kasta wuxuu noqdaa waddo, hawluhuna waxay noqdaan kaarar ku jira To Do, In Progress, Backlog ama Done, iyagoo leh qoraalladooda, summadaha, taariikhda ugu dambeysa, waqtiga la isticmaalay iyo hawlaha hoose; hawlaha la kaydiyay waxay noqdaan kaarar la kaydiyay.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Taiga gudihiisa, fur Admin > Project > Export oo soo deji kaydka mashruuca (marka hore kala fur faylka .json.gz), kadibna dhaji JSON-kiisa. Xaaladaha sheekooyinka isticmaalaha waxay noqdaan liisas, sheekooyinka isticmaalahana waxay noqdaan kaarar leh hawlahooda sidii hawlo hoose, epics iyo arrimaha waxay helaan waddooyin u gaar ah, sprint-yada, summadaha, faallooyinka iyo sifooyinka gaarka ahna way la socdaan. Lifaaqyada lama soo dejiyo.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Tasks.org gudihiisa, fur Settings, Backups oo dooro Export tasks, kadibna dhaji waxa ku jira faylkaas .json. Liisasku waxay noqdaan liisas, hawluhuna waxay noqdaan kaarar, iyagoo leh qoraalladooda, summadaha, taariikhaha, faallooyinka iyo hawlaha hoose; hawlaha la dhammeeyay waxay hayaan taariikhda la dhammeeyay, mudnaantuna waxay noqotaa goob gaar ah.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Ku dheji natiijada task export: taxane JSON ah ama hal hawl sadar kasta. Hawlaha dhammaaday waxay tagaan Done, project iyo priority waxay noqdaan calaamado, annotations waxay noqotaa faallooyin, depends-na waxay noqotaa ku-tiirsanaanta hawlaha xannibaya.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Teamwork.com gudihiisa, buuxi qaabka soo dejinta hawlaha Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) oo u kaydi sidii .xlsx, kadibna dooro faylkaas. Liisaska hawlaha waxay noqdaan liisas, hawluhuna waxay noqdaan kaarar; hawl ku bilaabata -, # ama > waxay noqotaa hawl hoose oo ka mid ah hawsha ka sarreysa (--, ## ama >> hal heer oo ka hooseeya). Dadka loo xilsaaray, taariikhaha iyo summadaha meeshooda ayay ku hadhaan; Priority, Estimated time iyo Complete waxay noqdaan goobo gaar ah.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: TickTick gudihiisa, fur Settings, Account, Backup & Import oo samee nuqul kayd ah, kadibna dhaji faylka CSV. Liis kasta oo TickTick ah wuxuu noqdaa waddo, tiirarkiisuna waxay noqdaan liisas; hawluhu waxay hayaan summadahooda, taariikhaha, liiska hubinta, mudnaanta iyo hawlaha hoose.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Ku dheji faylka todo.txt: hal hawl sadar kasta, sida ay u qoraan abka todo.txt iyo ababka la jaanqaada. Hawlaha dhammaaday ("x") waxay galaan Done, +project iyo @context waxay noqdaan summado, (A) wuxuu noqdaa summad mudnaan, due: iyo t: na waxay kala noqdaan taariikhda kama dambaysta ah iyo taariikhda bilowga.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Vikunja gudihiisa, fur Settings, dooro Data Export oo soo deji faylka .zip ee ay kuu soo dirto, kadibna dooro faylkaas, ama dhaji data.json ku jira. Baaldiyada Kanban waxay noqdaan liisas, hawluhuna waxay noqdaan kaarar, iyagoo leh calaamadahooda, dadka loo xilsaaray, taariikhaha, sharaxaadda, liisaska hawlaha sidii liisas hubin iyo faallooyinka; mudnaanta, boqolkiiba la qabtay iyo la qabtay waxay noqdaan goobo gaar ah. Lifaaqyada lama soo dejiyo.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Wrike gudihiisa, u soo saar mashruuc ama gal Excel, ama buuxi qaabka soo dejinta Excel ee Wrike, kadibna dooro faylkaas .xlsx. Safafka galka iyo mashruuca waxay noqdaan waddooyin, Status wuxuu noqdaa liisas, hawluhuna waxay noqdaan kaarar, iyagoo leh Key-gooda, hawsha waalidka, dadka loo xilsaaray, taariikhaha bilowga iyo dhammaadka, ku-tiirsanaanta iyo sharaxaadda; Priority, Duration iyo tiirarka kale waxay noqdaan goobo gaar ah.

r-wrike-workflow-note: Habka shaqada Wrike waa liis xaalado ah, mid kastaa wuxuu ku jiraa kooxda Active, Completed, Deferred ama Cancelled. Soo saaristu waxay u qortaa liisaska sabuuraddan sidii hal hab oo magaca sabuuradda leh, qaabka JSON ee API-ga Wrike u celiyo habababka shaqada: ku samee habkaas Wrike ka hor intaadan soo dejin soo saarista Excel ee Wrike ee sabuuradda, si xaaladihiisa loo dabaqo. Soo dejintu waxay akhrisaa JSON-kaas korka lagu dhajiyay, ha ahaado WeKan ama GET /workflows ee Wrike, una gelisaa sabuuradda la doortay: xaalad aan liis lahayn waxay noqotaa liis, xeerna wuxuu kaar u calaamadeeyaa la dhammeeyay marka loo raro xaalad Completed ama Cancelled, aan la dhammeyn marka uu ku jiro mid Active ama Deferred. Xeerarka otomaatiga ah ee Wrike laftiisa lagama soo saari karo Wrike.
